question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Tolerent**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelled word is '**Tolerent**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Tolerant**'.
 
• It means** 'ability to allow or accept something that you do not like or agree with.' **(सहिष्णु)
 
 
• **Example***: The present government is even less **tolerant** of dissent.**​*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Hygiene: **(the rules of) keeping yourself and things around you clean, in order to prevent disease. (स्वच्छता)
 
• **Catalogue: **a list of all the things that you can buy, see, etc. somewhere. (सूची)
 
• **Schedule: **a plan of things that will happen or of work that must be done. (अनुसूची)
